id: \rThis way to the contestants lounge, Champion \PN.
en: \rThis way to the contestants lounge, Champion \PN.
it: \rDa questa parte per la sala dei concorrenti, Campione \PN.

id: \rThis way to the contestants lounge.
en: \rThis way to the contestants lounge.
it: \rDa questa parte per la sala dei concorrenti.

id: \bSteven: Usually, I wouldn't stick around, but I'll make an exception for you. Good luck with Leon.
en: \bSteven: Usually, I wouldn't stick around, but I'll make an exception for you. Good luck with Leon.
it: \bRocco: Di solito non mi trattengo, ma per te farò un'eccezione. Buona fortuna con Dandel.

id: \bSteven: So you're here too. I'll give you a tough battle if we face each other later.
en: \bSteven: So you're here too. I'll give you a tough battle if we face each other later.
it: \bRocco: Quindi ci sei anche tu. Se ci affronteremo più tardi, ti darò filo da torcere.

id: \bSteven: I lost, but want to go looking for some rocks later?
en: \bSteven: I lost, but want to go looking for some rocks later?
it: \bRocco: Ho perso, ma ti va di andare a cercare qualche roccia più tardi?

id: \bCilan: Hey \PN! It's the final battle with Leon, right? Good luck!
en: \bCilan: Hey \PN! It's the final battle with Leon, right?  Good luck!
it: \bSpighetto: Ehi, \PN! È la lotta finale contro Dandel, vero?  Buona fortuna!

id: \bCilan: Hey \PN! If we face each other later, let's be sure to give each other a delightful battle!
en: \bCilan: Hey \PN! If we face each other later, let's be sure to give each other a delightful battle!
it: \bSpighetto: Ehi, \PN! Se ci affronteremo più tardi, offriamoci a vicenda una lotta deliziosa!

id: \bCilan: Hey \PN! That was a great battle earlier!
en: \bCilan: Hey \PN! That was a great battle earlier!
it: \bSpighetto: Ehi, \PN! Che bella lotta, prima!

id: \bBrock: You're here too, \PN? If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
en: \bBrock: You're here too, \PN? If you want I can groom one of your Pokémon. It may help it in battle.
it: \bBrock: Ci sei anche tu, \PN? Se vuoi posso fare la toelettatura a uno dei tuoi Pokémon. Potrebbe aiutarlo in lotta.

id: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \bBrock: Which Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \bBrock: A quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.
en: \bBrock: Oh, okay then.
it: \bBrock: Oh, va bene allora.

id: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!
en: \bBrock: There! \v[2] looks a lot better now!
it: \bBrock: Ecco! \v[2] sta molto meglio adesso!

id: \rReady to battle?
en: \rReady to battle?
it: \rTutto pronto per la lotta?

id: \rSorry, you can't participate. You need six different Pokémon to enter.
en: \rSorry, you can't participate. You need six different Pokémon to enter.
it: \rMi dispiace, non puoi partecipare. Per iscriverti ti servono sei Pokémon diversi.

id: \rThey must be of different species and hold different items.
en: \rThey must be of different species and hold different items.
it: \rDevono essere di specie diverse e tenere strumenti diversi.

id: \rCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
en: \rCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
it: \rAlcune specie esotiche, così come le uova, non sono ammesse.

id: \rPlease come through.
en: \rPlease come through.
it: \rPrego, passa pure.

id: \rTake your time to prepare. Your opponents are tough!
en: \rTake your time to prepare. Your opponents are tough!
it: \rPrenditi il tempo che ti serve per prepararti. I tuoi avversari sono tosti!

id: \rYou are currently not registered to battle.
en: \rYou are currently not registered to battle.
it: \rAl momento non hai un'iscrizione valida per lottare.

id: \bDrake: So, it's just Leon left, huh? You've got this, \PN.
en: \bDrake: So, it's just Leon left, huh? You've got this, \PN.
it: \bDrake: Allora manca solo Dandel, eh? Ce la puoi fare, \PN.

id: \bDrake: It's been a while, \PN! Let me give you a battle worthy of a Champion later.
en: \bDrake: It's been a while, \PN! Let me give you a battle worthy of a Champion later.
it: \bDrake: Quanto tempo, \PN! Più tardi ti offrirò una lotta degna di un Campione.

id: \bDrake: Close battle earlier. I know you'll beat the rest.
en: \bDrake: Close battle earlier. I know you'll beat the rest.
it: \bDrake: Lotta combattuta, prima. So che batterai tutti gli altri.

id: \rSerena: Hi \PN! One last battle until you're the Pokémon World Champion! You've got this!
en: \rSerena: Hi \PN! One last battle until you're the Pokémon World Champion! You've got this!
it: \rSerena: Ciao, \PN! Un'ultima lotta e sarai Campione del Mondo Pokémon! Ce la puoi fare!

id: \rSerena: Hi \PN! It makes sense that you'd be here too. There's no contests happening at the moment, so I thought it would be a great idea to take part!
en: \rSerena: Hi \PN! It makes sense that you'd be here too. There's no contests happening at the moment, so I thought it would be a great idea to take part!
it: \rSerena: Ciao, \PN! Ha senso che ci sia anche tu. Al momento non ci sono gare in corso, quindi ho pensato che sarebbe stata un'ottima idea partecipare!

id: \rSerena: Hi \PN! Let's keep doing our best, alright?
en: \rSerena: Hi \PN! Let's keep doing our best, alright?
it: \rSerena: Ciao, \PN! Continuiamo a dare il massimo, va bene?

id: \rMisty: It's the last battle with Leon, huh? Give it all you've got!
en: \rMisty: It's the last battle with Leon, huh? Give it all you've got!
it: \rMisty: È l'ultima lotta contro Dandel, eh? Dai tutto quello che hai!

id: \rMisty: \PN, you're here too? Well, I guess that makes sense, this is where all the hype is at.
en: \rMisty: \PN, you're here too? Well, I guess that makes sense, this is where all the hype is at.
it: \rMisty: \PN, ci sei anche tu? Beh, ha senso, è qui che c'è tutto l'entusiasmo.

id: \rI won't lose if we battle later!
en: \rI won't lose if we battle later!
it: \rNon perderò, se ci sfideremo più tardi!

id: \rMisty: I'll get you next time!
en: \rMisty: I'll get you next time!
it: \rMisty: La prossima volta ti batto!

id: \rHello Champion \PN! Welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello Champion \PN! Welcome to the Pokémon Center.
it: \rSalve, Campione \PN! Ti diamo il benvenuto al Centro Pokémon.

id: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
it: \rCiao, benvenuto al Centro Pokémon.

id: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
it: \rQui rimettiamo in forze i tuoi Pokémon stanchi.

id: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi far riposare i tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
it: \rBene, prendo i tuoi Pokémon per qualche secondo.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon potrebbero aver contratto il Pokérus.

id: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
it: \rSi sa poco del Pokérus, se non che si tratta di forme di vita microscopiche che si attaccano ai Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rThank you for waiting.
en: \rThank you for waiting.
it: \rGrazie per l'attesa.

id: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono di nuovo in piena forma.

id: \rWe hope to see you again!
en: \rWe hope to see you again!
it: \rTorna a trovarci!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
en: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati e sono in perfetta salute.

id: \rWe hope you excel!
en: \rWe hope you excel!
it: \rSpero che tu abbia successo!

id: \rCynthia: I know you can beat Leon, \PN.
en: \rCynthia: I know you can beat Leon, \PN.
it: \rCamilla: So che puoi battere Dandel, \PN.

id: \rCynthia: Oh my, it's \PN. I suppose you feel ready to take on the world now.
en: \rCynthia: Oh my, it's \PN. I suppose you feel ready to take on the world now.
it: \rCamilla: Oh, guarda chi c'è, \PN. Immagino che ora tu ti senta all'altezza di sfidare il mondo.

id: \rI won't be holding back if we end up battling each other later!
en: \rI won't be holding back if we end up battling each other later!
it: \rNon mi tratterrò, se finiremo per affrontarci più tardi!

id: \rCynthia: That was an exciting battle!
en: \rCynthia: That was an exciting battle!
it: \rCamilla: È stata una lotta emozionante!

id: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
en: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
it: \bSono il Maniaco delle Mosse Pokémon.

id: \bI know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up.
en: \bI know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up.
it: \bConosco ogni singola mossa che i Pokémon imparano crescendo.

id: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
en: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
it: \bColleziono anche Squame Cuore.

id: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
en: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
it: \bSe me ne porti una, insegnerò una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
en: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
it: \bOh! Eccola! È una Squama Cuore autentica al cento per cento!

id: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
en: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
it: \bFammi indovinare, vuoi che insegni una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
en: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
it: \bQuale Pokémon ha bisogno di lezioni?

id: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
en: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
it: \bSe i tuoi Pokémon devono imparare una mossa, torna con una Squama Cuore.

id: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an Egg.
en: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an Egg.
it: \bEh? Non c'è nemmeno una mossa che possa insegnare a un Uovo.

id: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
en: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
it: \bNeanche per sogno, non voglio avvicinarmi a un Pokémon Ombra...

id: \bSorry...
en: \bSorry...
it: \bMi dispiace...

id: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
en: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
it: \bA quanto pare non ho nessuna mossa da insegnare al tuo \v[3].

id: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
en: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
it: \bQuale mossa devo insegnare al tuo \v[3]?

id: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
en: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
it: \PN ha consegnato una Squama Cuore in cambio.

id: \bClemont: Hi \PN! All the best with the finals!
en: \bClemont: Hi \PN! All the best with the finals!
it: \bLem: Ciao, \PN! In bocca al lupo per la finale!

id: \bClemont: Hi \PN! If we face each other, the future will be now, thanks to science!
en: \bClemont: Hi \PN! If we face each other, the future will be now, thanks to science!
it: \bLem: Ciao, \PN! Se ci affronteremo, il futuro sarà adesso, grazie alla scienza!

id: \bClemont: Hi \PN! That was a great battle earlier.
en: \bClemont: Hi \PN! That was a great battle earlier.
it: \bLem: Ciao, \PN! Che bella lotta, prima.

id: \rMay: Hey \PN! It's the final battle until you're the Pokémon World Champion! All the best!
en: \rMay: Hey \PN! It's the final battle until you're the Pokémon World Champion! All the best!
it: \rVera: Ehi, \PN! È l'ultima lotta prima di diventare Campione del Mondo Pokémon! In bocca al lupo!

id: \rMay: Hi \PN, it's been a while! There's no contests happening at the moment, so I figured it would be a great idea to take part!
en: \rMay: Hi \PN, it's been a while! There's no contests happening at the moment, so I figured it would be a great idea to take part!
it: \rVera: Ciao, \PN, quanto tempo! Al momento non ci sono gare in corso, quindi ho pensato che sarebbe stata un'ottima idea partecipare!

id: \rMay: That was a nice battle earlier! We've gotta do that again soon!
en: \rMay: That was a nice battle earlier! We've gotta do that again soon!
it: \rVera: Bella lotta, prima! Dobbiamo rifarla presto!

id: \bAlder: Hmm, I suppose I can see you beating Leon if you give it your all.
en: \bAlder: Hmm, I suppose I can see you beating Leon if you give it your all.
it: \bNardo: Mmh, credo di poterti vedere battere Dandel, se dai il massimo.

id: \bAlder: Zzz... Oh, it's \PN. Honestly, I don't even know why I'm here, since I'm not even the current Champion of Unova.
en: \bAlder: Zzz... Oh, it's \PN. Honestly, I don't even know why I'm here, since I'm not even the current Champion of Unova.
it: \bNardo: Zzz... Oh, sei tu, \PN. Onestamente non so nemmeno perché sono qui, visto che non sono neanche l'attuale Campione di Unima.

id: \bAlder: That was a nice battle, I guess.
en: \bAlder: That was a nice battle, I guess.
it: \bNardo: Bella lotta, credo.

id: \bWhat do you mean I can't use my Groudon, Arceus, or Urshifu? This is rigged!
en: \bWhat do you mean I can't use my Groudon, Arceus, or Urshifu? This is rigged!
it: \bCome sarebbe che non posso usare il mio Groudon, Arceus o Urshifu? È tutto truccato!

id: \rBonnie: Hi \PN! I'm not actually participating, I'm just here with Clemont. Good luck!
en: \rBonnie: Hi \PN! I'm not actually participating, I'm just here with Clemont. Good luck!
it: \rClem: Ciao, \PN! In realtà non partecipo, sono qui solo con Lem. Buona fortuna!

id: \rDawn: Hey \PN! You've got the finals next, huh? I'll be cheering you on with Piplup!
en: \rDawn: Hey \PN! You've got the finals next, huh? I'll be cheering you on with Piplup!
it: \rLucinda: Ehi, \PN! Ora tocca a te la finale, eh? Farò il tifo per te con Piplup!

id: \rDawn: Hi \PN! Good to see you here too. There's no contests happening at the moment, so I figured it would be a great idea to take part!
en: \rDawn: Hi \PN! Good to see you here too. There's no contests happening at the moment, so I figured it would be a great idea to take part!
it: \rLucinda: Ciao, \PN! Che bello vederti anche qui. Al momento non ci sono gare in corso, quindi ho pensato che sarebbe stata un'ottima idea partecipare!

id: \rDawn: That was a close battle earlier! I'll be cheering you on with Piplup from here!
en: \rDawn: That was a close battle earlier! I'll be cheering you on with Piplup from here!
it: \rLucinda: Che lotta combattuta, prima! Farò il tifo per te con Piplup da qui!

id: \rHello, World Champion \PN! Would you like to start a new season of the Pokémon World Championships?
en: \rHello, World Champion \PN! Would you like to start a new season of the Pokémon World Championships?
it: \rSalve, Campione Mondiale \PN! Vuoi iniziare una nuova stagione dei Campionati Mondiali Pokémon?

id: \rHello. Here you can register for the Pokémon World Championships!
en: \rHello. Here you can register for the Pokémon World Championships!
it: \rSalve. Qui puoi iscriverti ai Campionati Mondiali Pokémon!

id: \rWould you like to register?
en: \rWould you like to register?
it: \rVuoi iscriverti?

id: \rLet me take your name...
en: \rLet me take your name...
it: \rRegistro il tuo nome...

id: \rAll set! Contestant \PN, please go through when you're ready.
en: \rAll set! Contestant \PN, please go through when you're ready.
it: \rTutto pronto! Concorrente \PN, puoi passare quando vuoi.

id: \rNo problem. Have a great day, Champion \PN!
en: \rNo problem. Have a great day, Champion \PN!
it: \rNessun problema. Buona giornata, Campione \PN!

id: \rNo problem. Have a good day.
en: \rNo problem. Have a good day.
it: \rNessun problema. Buona giornata.

id: \rWould you like to know more about the Pokémon World Championships?
en: \rWould you like to know more about the Pokémon World Championships?
it: \rVuoi saperne di più sui Campionati Mondiali Pokémon?

id: \rThe Pokémon World Championships is a prestigious tournament where all trainers in the whole world come together to determine who's the strongest.
en: \rThe Pokémon World Championships is a prestigious tournament where all trainers in the whole world come together to determine who's the strongest.
it: \rI Campionati Mondiali Pokémon sono un torneo prestigioso in cui gli Allenatori di tutto il mondo si riuniscono per stabilire chi è il più forte.

id: \rIt starts with a group stage where you're matched with 3 other contestants, then a single elimination stage with 10 rounds.
en: \rIt starts with a group stage where you're matched with 3 other contestants, then a single elimination stage with 10 rounds.
it: \rSi comincia con una fase a gironi, in cui affronti altri 3 concorrenti, seguita da una fase a eliminazione diretta di 10 turni.

id: \rBattles can be 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 and in them, you're only allowed to use 1 item and you're forced into the "Set" battle style, whatever that means.
en: \rBattles can be 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 and in them, you're only allowed to use 1 item and you're forced into the "Set" battle style, whatever that means.
it: \rGli incontri possono essere 1 contro 1, 2 contro 2 o 3 contro 3; puoi usare solo 1 strumento e lo stile di lotta "Fisso" è obbligatorio, qualunque cosa voglia dire.

id: \rLastly, battles take place on fields with special effects. What do I mean by that? You'll find out as soon as you step in!
en: \rLastly, battles take place on fields with special effects. What do I mean by that? You'll find out as soon as you step in!
it: \rInfine, gli incontri si svolgono su campi con effetti speciali. Cosa intendo? Lo scoprirai appena ci metterai piede!

id: \rOh, ok. All the best!
en: \rOh, ok. All the best!
it: \rOh, ok. In bocca al lupo!

id: \rIris: Hi \PN! I'll be cheering you on with your battle against Leon!
en: \rIris: Hi \PN! I'll be cheering you on with your battle against Leon!
it: \rIris: Ciao, \PN! Farò il tifo per te nella lotta contro Dandel!

id: \rIris: Hey \PN! I can't wait to show you how much I've improved since our last battle.
en: \rIris: Hey \PN! I can't wait to show you how much I've improved since our last battle.
it: \rIris: Ehi, \PN! Non vedo l'ora di mostrarti quanto sono migliorata dalla nostra ultima lotta.

id: \rIris: I still can't believe I lost... but I'll get you next time! For now, I'll be cheering you on.
en: \rIris: I still can't believe I lost... but I'll get you next time! For now, I'll be cheering you on.
it: \rIris: Ancora non ci credo di aver perso... ma la prossima volta ti batto! Per ora, farò il tifo per te.

id: \w[signskin]To stadium
en: \w[signskin]To stadium
it: \w[signskin]Allo stadio

id: \rDidn't realise you needed 6 'mons. Never had ta catch more cuz I beat all the gym leaders with my level 100 Lucario that megas and dynamaxes.
en: \rDidn't realise you needed 6 'mons. Never had ta catch more cuz I beat all the gym leaders with my level 100 Lucario that megas and dynamaxes.
it: \rNon sapevo che servissero 6 Pokémon. Mai dovuto catturarne altri, ho battuto tutti i Capipalestra col mio Lucario di livello 100 che megaevolve e si dynamaxa.

id: \rDiantha: I'm rooting for you to beat Leon.
en: \rDiantha: I'm rooting for you to beat Leon.
it: \rDiantha: Faccio il tifo per te contro Dandel.

id: \rDiantha: Oh, it's \PN! I'm excited at the chance to finally get to battle you in an official match.
en: \rDiantha: Oh, it's \PN! I'm excited at the chance to finally get to battle you in an official match.
it: \rDiantha: Oh, sei tu, \PN! Sono entusiasta di poterti finalmente sfidare in un incontro ufficiale.

id: \rDiantha: That was a fun battle.
en: \rDiantha: That was a fun battle.
it: \rDiantha: È stata una lotta divertente.

id: \bLance: Beat Leon for me, alright? I know you can do it.
en: \bLance: Beat Leon for me, alright? I know you can do it.
it: \bLance: Batti Dandel anche per me, d'accordo? So che puoi farcela.

id: \bLance: Good to see you, \PN. I won't hold back if we battle.
en: \bLance: Good to see you, \PN. I won't hold back if we battle.
it: \bLance: Che piacere vederti, \PN. Non mi tratterrò, se ci sfideremo.

id: \bLance: Close battle earlier. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bLance: Close battle earlier. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bLance: Lotta combattuta, prima. Buona fortuna per il resto.

id: \rThis room is only for contestants of the Pokémon World Championships.
en: \rThis room is only for contestants of the Pokémon World Championships.
it: \rQuesta sala è riservata ai concorrenti dei Campionati Mondiali Pokémon.

id: \bLeon: Look like it's the two of us now, huh? Let's both give it our all and have a Champion Time!
en: \bLeon: Look like it's the two of us now, huh? Let's both give it our all and have a Champion Time!
it: \bDandel: A quanto pare siamo rimasti noi due, eh? Diamo entrambi il massimo e godiamoci un Champion Time!

id: \bLeon: Ah, \PN. I'll be sure to give you a Champion Time if we battle later.
en: \bLeon: Ah, \PN. I'll be sure to give you a Champion Time if we battle later.
it: \bDandel: Ah, \PN. Se ci sfideremo più tardi, ti farò vivere un vero Champion Time.

id: \bForget about the battles. Do you see everything they are selling here?
en: \bForget about the battles. Do you see everything they are selling here?
it: \bLascia perdere le lotte. Hai visto tutto quello che vendono qui?

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
